Group rides in West Virginia

2 recurring group rides around West Virginia: 1 road, 1 mountain bike. 1 roll on weeknights, 1 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with MAMBA Weekly Group Ride in Morgantown — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Mountain State Wheelers Saturday Ride runs a/B/C categories (6–18 mph).
